context: Remediates two defects found by a read-only audit of the already-merged PR #713 (TP-DMX-AUDITOR-ROUTER-PAL-CLINK-002). Audit report: claudedocs/pr713-auditor-router-pal-clink-audit-2026-05-30.md. Closes the external PAL-clink auditor's own un-actioned required fix (F2) and the dead-test/import defect (F8).

commands.result: 52 passed (was 47 passed + 3 failed on origin/main before fix; fixed 3 + added 2)
26/26 PASS before adding this bundle; re-run after add must remain clean

details.detail: 3 tests (test_as_args_shlex_parsing, test_detect_mutation_flags_new_tokens, test_canonical_role_prompt_path_strict) changed from `from auditor_router.pal_clink` to `from tools.auditor_router.pal_clink`. They previously errored ModuleNotFoundError under canonical pytest; now collected and passing. These exercise security hardening (shlex parsing, execute/run/apply mutation tokens, absolute/traversal/whitespace path rejection).

build_pal_clink_embedded_audit_object now coerces any non-SKIPPED status whose auditor_model resolves to 'unknown' (no audit-safe underlying CLI) into a schema-valid SKIPPED object. Pre-fix repro: unproven route -> auditor_model='unknown' + NEEDS_SUPERVISOR -> embedded_audit.schema.json error "'unknown' should not be valid under {'const': 'unknown'}". Post-fix: SKIPPED, 0 schema errors.

tools/pr_steward/classifier.py BLOCKING_AUDITS = {FAIL, NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, SKIPPED} -> coerced SKIPPED is still blocking. Coercion branch also prepends a 'treat as blocking' entry to remaining_risks and records the original status in skip_reason, preserving the signal for consumers that do not key off status.

Added test_normalize_unproven_route_emits_schema_valid_skipped and test_build_embedded_audit_unknown_model_any_status_coerced_to_skipped (asserts SKIPPED-field invariants + schema validity across FAIL/PASS/PASS_WITH_RISKS/NEEDS_SUPERVISOR, and that a proven route is unaffected). Strengthened test_payload_type_non_dict_never_raises with assert_schema_valid.
normalize_pal_clink_audit_output has no production caller (only tests); build_pal_clink_embedded_audit_object is called only by normalize. No external prod callers of the changed functions.

findings.title: embedded_audit could emit auditor_model='unknown' under non-SKIPPED status (schema violation)
findings.body: Guarded at the build_pal_clink_embedded_audit_object choke-point: non-SKIPPED + unattributable model now coerces to a schema-valid SKIPPED object that the PR Steward still treats as blocking. Reproduced before fix; 0 schema errors after. This was the external PAL-clink auditor's own required fix on PR #713, shipped unactioned.

findings.title: Three security-hardening tests dead due to wrong import path
findings.body: Fixed `from auditor_router.pal_clink` -> `from tools.auditor_router.pal_clink` (lines 766/773/779). These previously errored under canonical pytest and were not collected by CI (the required Unit Tests job does not include tests/auditor_router/).

findings.title: Coercion could lose NEEDS_SUPERVISOR vs SKIPPED observability
findings.body: pal/codereview (gpt-5.2) observation. Addressed: skip_reason now embeds the original status ('coerced from {status}') and remaining_risks is prepended with an explicit blocking marker.

findings.body: pal/codereview observation. Deferred as out-of-scope: not introduced by this fix; widening the diff into an untouched signature is avoided per minimal-change discipline.
